svg.title: VIGIL-88, incident detection that reasons across time
svg.desc: Plate V. The title VIGIL-88, drawn as exact construction geometry: public code, a P0 foundation, nothing detected yet. Three lanes along one time axis. Capture: frames arrive one after another, each a solid mark. Detector: a null detector answers every frame with an empty ring. Evidence: a dashed line toward a candidate event and an incident, drawn dashed because neither exists yet. An ember marks the latest frame. A frame is evidence, not a verdict.
